Understand the provision.

Original plain-language explanations. The official text controls.

International law · UN 2(4)

Threat or use of force

A central reference for interstate force. Whether a cyber operation meets the threshold depends on the circumstances and legal analysis, not merely the label “attack”.

Verify in the official text
International law · UN 51

Self-defence

Addresses the inherent right of individual or collective self-defence if an armed attack occurs, subject to the Charter. The cyber armed-attack threshold is fact-specific and debated.

Verify in the official text
International law · IHL

Distinction, proportionality, precautions

Where international humanitarian law applies, these principles govern relevant conduct. Dual-use infrastructure and indirect effects require careful factual and legal assessment. The Tallinn Manual is commentary, not a treaty.

Verify in the official text
